<section class="about-intro">
<div class="about-heading" role="heading" aria-level="1">About</div>

<p class="about-subtitle">Research Associate | Deep Learning &amp; Human-Centered AI</p>

<p>
I am a Research Associate at the <strong>University of Sheffield</strong>, working on multi-agent AI systems for automated corporate ethics benchmarking and forced-labour risk assessment across global supply chains. My research combines <strong>deep learning, multimodal learning, and human-centered AI</strong>, with a particular focus on cross-domain facial expression recognition, affective computing, and socially responsible AI applications.
</p>

<p>
I hold an <strong>MSc in Computer Science (Distinction)</strong> from Manchester Metropolitan University, where my dissertation on deep learning-based cross-domain facial expression recognition scored 80/100. My work has been published in venues including <em>Knowledge-Based Systems</em>, <em>ACML 2025</em>, and <em>IEEE Access</em>, and I collaborate across disciplines at the intersection of AI, operations management, and social impact.
</p>

<p>
Before moving into research, I spent several years as a software engineer building enterprise applications, which now shapes how I approach building reliable, well-engineered AI systems rather than one-off research prototypes.
</p>
